description: Plan a multi-layer feature as parallel waves before writing any code. goal (required): the request in plain words, e.g. "inventory system with stock levels, a dashboard and deploy to vercel". Returns wave 0 (the driver, or ONE agent when the code is unmapped, freezes the contract: schema + API + props + test scenarios, AND the context pack ctx-<slug>.md next to it: per lane path:line + current code excerpt + pattern to copy) -> wave 1 parallel builders (data, backend, frontend, tests; the driver keeps the most coupled lane) -> wave 2 integration -> wave 3 parallel verifiers (test, typecheck, security, performance, review) -> wave 4 gated deploy, with per-task file ownership, acceptance checks and dependsOn. Every lane brief ends with the turn-economy footer (batch reads, first edit by turn 5, no project-wide lint/test/build). A goal with no data/backend/frontend/pipeline signal answers shape no-fanout; work touching 8 known files or fewer (inlineThreshold 8) is done inline unless it splits into 2+ independent slices of about 5 minutes each. Pass the returned tasks array (JSON) straight to task_distribute.

includeDeploy.description: Force the deploy wave on even if the goal does not mention shipping

name: plan_feature
